basics.headline: Full-Stack Developer
summary: I'm currently a Computer Science junior at Fisk University and I enjoy automating boring work. My background is in software engineering, with a particular interest in automation, AI, and systems that solve real problems.
Beyond the code, I care about product. I like thinking through what to build, how it should work, and whether anyone actually needs it. Basically, I enjoy the part where an idea stops being an idea.

highlights: Participated in a structured summer research programme
Collaborated with faculty and peers on applied research workflows
Designed and prototyped software features end to end
Worked across the stack from interface concepts to implementation
